newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends weak on wheat, soy spillover.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends weak on wheat, soy spillover.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled lower on spillover pressure from late weakness in CBOT corn and soy, traders said.

Spring wheat had been under pressure throughout much of the lightly traded session from technical selling and a general lack of buying interest. But the late-session slide in wheat and beans compounded losses.
CBOT soybeans hit new contract highs during the session but were dragged lower by a wave of profit taking.
"When they crashed, we crashed," an MGE trader said. "What that means for tomorrow I don't know."

MGE spring wheat settled 2-1/2 to 7-1/2 cents lower, with May down 2-1/2 cents at $4.41 per bushel. New-crop September shed 6-3/4 cents to close at $4.39-1/4, and July lost 7-1/4 cents to settle at $4.41-1/2.
